theme_and_archetype.description: Premium, AI-native productivity OS for multi-project founders. High-contrast, minimal cognitive load, tactile, and highly responsive. Feels like a smart AI executive control room.

colors.strategy: Monochromatic structural grays + one vibrant kinetic trigger. No soft SaaS gradients. Use stark contrasts to direct attention.

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (Mode B) + Asymmetric blocks
rules: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 for main dashboard grids
Tight gaps: gap-4 or gap-6 for high data density
Every pixel utilized; use h-full on children for uniform height
Cardless or sharp rectangles (max rounded-md, 6px). Avoid heavily rounded-xl look.
Asymmetric layouts: left-aligned content, generous negative space.
Progressive disclosure: hide non-essential filters and actions until hover or click.

components_and_surfaces.cards: Flat solid background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no heavy drop shadows. On hover: subtle ring or border color change, -translate-y-[1px].
components_and_surfaces.glassmorphism: Used strictly for floating elements (command palettes, sticky headers, modals, toasts). Must be backdrop-blur-xl with backdrop-saturate-150 and 1px inner stroke.
components_and_surfaces.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-md). Primary buttons use the kinetic accent color (Vermilion/Orange). Secondary are ghost or outlined.
components_and_surfaces.forms: Left-aligned labels, dense inputs. Use Shadcn customized for high contrast.
components_and_surfaces.charts: Recharts or Shadcn Charts. Use monochromatic tones + accent color for the main data line. No rainbow palettes.

motion_and_interactions.strategy: Micro-animations on every interaction. Linear-like speed. Fast and tactile.
rules: Hover states for all interactive elements (must explicitly set text color on hover).
Focus states must have HIGHER contrast.
Smooth layout transitions (layoutId) for tabs and filters.
Staggered entrance animations for lists (opacity 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0, duration 0.2s max).

images.description: Dark textured surface with warm light reflection - used for premium hero or empty state background accents
Professional avatar portrait for user profile in the dashboard

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a 14-module AI-native productivity dashboard strictly following these guidelines.
Ensure complete light/dark theme toggle implementation using standard CSS variables injected into tailwind.
Replace generic UI elements with high-density, high-contrast layouts mimicking Linear/Superhuman. Focus on keyboard-driven feel.
Use Framer Motion for micro-interactions but keep them fast (duration <= 0.2s).
Use Outfit for headers, Manrope for body text, JetBrains Mono for metadata.
NEVER use placeholder images; use the provided image URLs.
Ensure 'data-testid' is on every actionable item.
